title: Didn’t check into hotel, caused chaos
content: Okay so I’ve been having these dreams for years and I’ve realized that most if not all of us are dreaming of the same locations. One of them being a large “hotel/resort” This is the second time I have dreamt of this. I was on a spaceship knowingly flying into “mallworld” with a bunch of strangers. When we landed, we saw a long line outside of the hotel all full of people waiting to check in. For some reason my mind told me not to go on the line and to just explore as I normally would. As soon as I turned away from the hotel, a police officer stopped me and told me I needed to check in. When I explained that I wasn’t going to stay in the hotel, I just stopped and looked at me. Then, everyone in the city stopped what they were doing and looked at me. The police officer told me to leave and everyone joined in. This sounds crazy but I know my mall world people might understand. I have not been able to stop thinking about it. I have always struggled with being fully lucid in mall world. Something was telling me that once you checked into the hotel, your ability to be lucid was weakened. Definitely the weirdest one I’ve had in quite some time. I have since dreamed about being back in mall world nearly every night and I notice I just naturally check into the hotel or will already be staying there without even remembering how I got there.
